creative_brief.emotional_promise: Make one small object feel like a pocket comet: immediately inviting, gently surprising, and easy to try again.
creative_brief.format_rationale: One solid with one clear gesture does not need a booklet. A roomy duplex card keeps the exact object, first flick, reset, troubleshooting, care, and safety together without tiny type or filler.
teaching_arc: Identify the one included Comet Pebble.
Find the raised smiling-star home cue.
Place the broad oval sole down.
Release and let the wobble stop.
Reset star-up and troubleshoot force or surface.
Store, care for, and use the pebble safely.
typography: Display and action labels — embedded DejaVu Sans Bold
Instructions and captions — embedded DejaVu Sans
creative_brief.visual_motif: A gold star marks home while dotted orbit arcs and numbered capsules lead from star-up to flick to free wobble; names and shapes repeat every color cue.

findings: The first cover render obscured its tagline, while the second action heading and final troubleshooting row clipped at their panel edges.
The first-use panels relied on generic arrows and did not show which exact product sole or shoulder the owner should use.
The light gold orbit and secondary headings weakened in grayscale.
resolved_changes: Moved and reduced the cover render, lowered its orbit, and resized or shortened action and troubleshooting copy so every line renders clear.
Added exact sealed top and right Made views to the STAR UP and SIDE FLICK panels, reinforced by distinct star and arrow cues.
Darkened the gold accent and retained labels, numbers, arrows, and shapes so the complete reading path survives grayscale.
